# Sockets

Address families, socket types and options, and the calls that open, bind and connect sockets.

<h2 id="socket"><code>Socket</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Socket(
    domain: int32,
    kind: int32,
    protocol: int32
) -> int64
```

Opens a socket.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/socket.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/socket.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Socket.rux#L94)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type    | Description                                                                                                |
| ---------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `domain`   | `int32` | the address family, such as [`AF_INET`](/docs/api/macos/socket#af-inet)                                    |
| `kind`     | `int32` | the socket type, such as [`SOCK_STREAM`](/docs/api/macos/socket#sock-stream), combined with `SOCK_CLOEXEC` |
| `protocol` | `int32` | the protocol, or zero for the family's default                                                             |

**Returns**: the new descriptor, or a negative error number

<h2 id="connect"><code>Connect</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Connect(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    address: *opaque,
    length: uint32
) -> int64
```

Connects a socket to `address`, waiting for a stream connection to be made.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/connect.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/connect.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Socket.rux#L105)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                 |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                  |
| `address` | `*opaque`        | the address, a `sockaddr`   |
| `length`  | `uint32`         | the address's size in bytes |

**Returns**: zero, or a negative error number

<h2 id="listen"><code>Listen</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Listen(fd: FileDescriptor, backlog: int32) -> int64
```

Makes a bound stream socket accept connections.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/listen.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/listen.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Socket.rux#L126)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                  |
| --------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                   |
| `backlog` | `int32`          | how many connections may wait to be accepted |

**Returns**: zero, or a negative error number

<h2 id="accept4"><code>Accept4</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Accept4(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    address: *var opaque,
    length: *var uint32,
    flags: int32
) -> int64
```

Accepts a waiting connection as a new socket.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/accept.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/accept.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Socket.rux#L138)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                                                                   |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the listening socket                                                                          |
| `address` | `*var opaque`    | receives the peer's address, or null                                                          |
| `length`  | `*var uint32`    | the address buffer's size, then the address's, or null                                        |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | ignored: macOS has no `accept4`, and the new socket is closed on exec by the caller if wanted |

**Returns**: the new descriptor, or a negative error number

<h2 id="sendto"><code>SendTo</code></h2>

```rux
pub func SendTo(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    buffer: *opaque,
    count: uint,
    flags: int32,
    address: *opaque,
    length: uint32
) -> int64
```

Sends bytes on a socket, to `address` when it is not connected.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/sendto.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/sendto.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Socket.rux#L152)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                     |
| --------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                      |
| `buffer`  | `*opaque`        | the bytes                                       |
| `count`   | `uint`           | how many                                        |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags such as `MSG_NOSIGNAL`                    |
| `address` | `*opaque`        | the destination, or null for a connected socket |
| `length`  | `uint32`         | the destination's size                          |

**Returns**: the bytes sent, or a negative error number

<h2 id="receivefrom"><code>ReceiveFrom</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ReceiveFrom(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    buffer: *var opaque,
    count: uint,
    flags: int32,
    address: *var opaque,
    length: *var uint32
) -> int64
```

Receives bytes from a socket, and where they came from.

**See also**: [https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/recvfrom.2.html](https://keith.github.io/xcode-man-pages/recvfrom.2.html)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Socket.rux#L166)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                            |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                             |
| `buffer`  | `*var opaque`    | receives the bytes                                     |
| `count`   | `uint`           | how many fit                                           |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags, or zero                                         |
| `address` | `*var opaque`    | receives the sender's address, or null                 |
| `length`  | `*var uint32`    | the address buffer's size, then the address's, or null |

**Returns**: the bytes received, zero once a stream's peer closed it, or a negative error number

<h2 id="shutdown"><code>Shutdown</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Shutdown(fd: FileDescriptor, how: int32) -> int64
```

Ends one or both directions of a connection.

| `how` | `int32`          | `SHUT_RD`, `SHUT_WR` or `SHUT_RDWR` |
